messages:
penny: Heads-up - legal cleared the v1 -> v2 deprecation notice. We need a single-page migration cheat-sheet + a short FAQ for SDK breakage. Target publish Tue 11:00 UTC.
omar: I'll run a repo-wide scan for /v1/ usage and positional arg patterns. Will attach a CSV with file:path:line.
tess: important: mobile SDKs still accept positional in older releases. Add an "upgrade SDK versions" table with the minimum safe versions.
sasha: propose a tiny "docs-only" compatibility snippet for JS and Py that maps old shorthand to the new explicit payload. Mark DO NOT USE IN PROD.
penny: yes, but also include clear guidance: shims are short-term only. Show an explicit migration example for chat to new messages payload.
omar: scan results: 58 instances of /v1/invoke across docs + samples; 14 positional arg spots in mobile and tutorial. I'll open per-repo PRs.
docs-bot: PR opened: redwood/docs#8201 by @omar - "migration cheat-sheet + snippet fixes" (CI: pending).
infra-bot: note: Dedicated customers may have pinned weights. Add a rollback snippet and contact path for infra ops.
tess: I'll draft the SDK table. For iOS: >= 3.2.0, Android: >= 4.0.0, Python: >= 2.6.0, TS: >= 1.9.0. Will include code examples for each.
sasha: sample snippet (JS docs-only): ```js
// docs-only shim - temporary
function normalize(req){
  if (Array.isArray(req)) return { input: req };
  if (req.content && !req.input) req.input = req.content;
  return req;
}
await client.invoke(normalize(userReq));
```
penny: add a migration checklist: 1) update SDKs, 2) swap model ids, 3) verify embed dims, 4) run smoke-matrix. Add console curl to check alias mapping.
omar: creating smoke-matrix job in docs CI that runs canonical snippets against staging-v1 and staging-v2 and compares embed vector lengths and streaming continuity.
docs-bot: smoke CI job created: docs/ci/migration-matrix#82.
infra-bot: rollback snippet for Dedicated (py): ```py
# pin legacy model for tenant
client.update_tenant_config(tenant_id='t-xyz', model_pin='open-embed-legacy')
# notify infra: infra@redwood.ai with subject: "Model pin request - tenant t-xyz"
```
tess: adding FAQ entry: "Why are my embeddings shorter?" -> explain alias swap and vector dim changes, show how to re-index vectors if needed.
sasha: small doc hygiene: replace any example links that reference /v1/models with friendly redirects; add a redirect map in internal/redirects.md.
penny: owners: cheat-sheet (penny), sample fixes (omar), SDK table (tess), redirect map (sasha), smoke CI (omar). Add owners to PR descriptions.
omar: opened sample PRs: redwood/sample-next#201, redwood/sample-python#88, redwood/mobile-examples#34. docs-bot: links added to docs PR. CI: running.
docs-bot: CI: snippet-lint found 3 mobile examples using positional args. Assigning to @omar.
omar: fixing mobile examples, bumping SDK references in readmes.
infra-bot: reminder: do not mention internal alias names in public docs; use abstract "new model id" language in customer-facing copy.
sasha: updated internal redirect map draft: /models/open-embed-legacy -> open-embed-1024-v2; /models/chat-old -> chat-small-v2. Pushed to internal/redirects.md (WIP).
tess: CI update: tests caught an embed-dim mismatch in sample-python tutorial; fixed by updating expected vector length. Pushing patch.
docs-bot: all checks passed for redwood/docs#8201 and linked sample PRs after fixes. :white_check_mark: 
penny: final steps: schedule merge Tue 10:30 UTC, publish bundle at 11:00 UTC, and trigger redirect deploy. I'll coordinate the email to integrators.
sasha: I'll prepare a short "how we tested" blurb for the guide describing the smoke-matrix so customers can reproduce locally.
penny: thanks everyone. Please capture any unexpected customer regressions under "deprecation-rollout" and ping #incidents if severity > P2.
omar: noted - I'll keep an eye on sample metrics after redirect deploy.
tess: thumbs up. Small wins = smoother rollout.
